correctness.rationale: The proof covers every odd prime p, k>=1 and d>=1, with exact normalization and both discriminant strata. For nonsingular traces, the rank equals order(z^2) in a cyclic split/norm-one group and the two-to-one trace quotient gives the totient formula. For p>=5 and discriminant-zero traces, derivatives at ±2 establish exact valuation v_p(U_{p^j})=j and rank p^k. For p=3, U_3=s²−1 and the subsequent companion iterates each have valuation 1, giving v_3(U_{3^jm})=v_3(s²−1)+j−1 for 3∤m; counting e-strata yields the exceptional distribution. The supplementary direct modular recurrence checker passes all 4,815 parameters in 25 rings; finite tests do not substitute for the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: This complete first-zero rank distribution over recurrence parameters at all odd prime powers was not found in the materially inspected predecessor or later source statements or in research-index queries. Park poses precisely the prime-power parameter-dependence direction; later first-kind Chebyshev dynamics has overlapping methods but does not give the second-kind rank census. General cyclic-order formulae and recurrence identities are credited. Search failures alone do not establish novelty; possible unindexed root-count theorems remain a risk.
residual_risks: A general published or unindexed theorem on exact root multiplicities of second-kind Chebyshev polynomials over odd prime-power rings might subsume this result without using the same terminology.
Only materially relevant sections, rather than all pages of every related manuscript, were inspected; an unobserved reduction in broader first-kind Chebyshev dynamics literature is possible.
Indexing limitations and incomplete access to every historical research record prevent an absolute uniqueness claim; independent originality review is not performed.

value.rationale: The theorem supplies a closed finite-divisor formula for a natural established rank-of-apparition invariant over all odd prime-power moduli, answering the parameter dependence explicitly suggested in Park 2014. It includes all discriminant-zero parameters and reveals a characteristic-three exceptional valuation tower, rather than a routine unmotivated instance or table recomputation. The exact attainable-rank support and multiplicities are complete for the stated infinite family.
